changes.title: Lake shores
items: The biome lakes' shores are dressed: palms round the oases, bones and drowned trunks in the tar pits, reeds round the lily ponds, ice chunks by the tarns and glaciers, glowing lava rocks and scorched trees by the lava, and pale mineral crust round the hot springs
Lava lakes now cast a warm glow on the trees around them

changes.title: Biome forests
items: The forests now look like their part of the world: snowy firs in the north, lichen-hung wind-bent trees in the mountains, lush green on charred trunks in the volcanic east, dusty sage scrub in the badlands, sunlit savanna in the south, moss-hung swamp, flowering jungle vines in the west and deep mossy rainforest in the north-west
Islands between two biomes mix both
Some trees moved home: no more hawthorns in the savanna or wild olives on the glacier crags

changes.title: Studio play
items: The treehouse Studio has a drum kit, a modular synth and a microphone: walk up to one and every key plays it (Esc steps away). Number keys 1 to 4 run the Studio's own loop and its tempo, 5 to 9 change the sound
The record shelf now stands on the Terrace beside your decks
